hypothesis: A frozen MR-MT3 transcription front end, projected a priori to guitar-family programs and the playable 20-fret standard-tuning pitch range, will achieve materially higher pitch+onset precision than Basic Pitch while retaining enough recall to pass the same Stage-A feasibility bar.

frontEnd.name: MR-MT3
frontEnd.exactVersionRule: Pin an exact released mt3-infer version, vendored MR-MT3 backend commit/provenance, checkpoint URL, checkpoint byte size and SHA-256 before any real-media execution.
frontEnd.licenseRule: Require MIT-compatible wrapper/backend provenance and freeze it in the synthetic receipt before authorization.

fixedProjection.purpose: Convert multitrack MIDI output to guitar-note candidates without post-hoc tuning.
fixedProjection.acceptedMidiPitchRange: 40-83 inclusive, matching standard tuning E2 through high-e string fret 19
fixedProjection.rationale: These are instrument-contract constraints derived from the product target, not fitted on P1/P2 outcomes.

dataScope.captures: same exact 4 P1 + 4 P2 direct-input captures and frozen 200-frame scoring intervals

scoring.primary: same corrected Stage-A one-to-one pitch+onset scorer, 50 ms onset tolerance, exact simultaneous same-pitch duplicates collapsed for pitch-only scoring while ambiguity is retained
scoring.secondary: pitch+onset+offset score at frozen 50 ms offset tolerance

criteria: aggregate false positives <= 31 (no more than one FP per scored reference on the same eight-crop target)
zero optimizer steps, zero confidence/threshold search, exact checkpoint identity verified, unresolved labels = 0
advancementCriteria.note: The added precision/FP requirements directly address the Basic Pitch failure mode and are predeclared before MR-MT3 sees P1/P2.

syntheticGateRequirements: pin exact mt3-infer release and MR-MT3 checkpoint SHA-256
verify guitar-program filtering and 40-83 pitch-range filtering
verify crop clipping and corrected duplicate-pitch scorer reuse
verify deterministic MIDI parsing on a synthetic multitrack fixture

outcomes.pass: Design-only Stage B string/fret assignment using frozen note evidence; no automatic fitting.
outcomes.fail: Stop generic frozen pretrained-front-end branch. Next offline design should move to a commercial-safe synthetic/data-diversity strategy rather than trying a third generic AMT front end.
outcomes.infrastructureFailure: Fix only adapter/provenance issues; do not reinterpret as a model result.
